title: Exploring the antibacterial properties of ZnO nanorods–CuO nanoflowers: a mode of action approach
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,32995-33005
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04095G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Vijay S. Ghodake, Pramod A. Koyale, Satyajeet S. Patil, Pramod S. Patil, Sagar D. Delekar
ZnO nanorods functionalized with CuO nanoflowers (ZC NCS) show enhanced antibacterial activity. Their high surface area and ROS generation disrupt microbial membranes, highlighting ZC NCs as promising scalable materials for healthcare applications.
